# @cortex-ui/sidebar-open-project

Open project: the native folder dialog, then frame.project.open; its caret menu adds New project from GitHub (a clone into the dev folder).

- **Plugin id:** `sidebar.open-project`
- **Slot:** `sidebar.actions@1`
- **Build:** `npm run build` → `dist/` (`index.js`, `style.css`, `manifest.json`)
- **Test:** `npm test`

React, ReactDOM and `@cortex/sdk` are peer dependencies the workbench provides.

<!-- slot-contract:start (generated by ui/scripts/readme-contracts.mjs) -->
## Slot contract

- **Fills:** `sidebar.actions@1` as `sidebar.open-project`
- **Props:** none besides `slot`
- **Hosts:** no slots
- **Workbench state read:** none
- **Workbench state written:** `projectId`, `sessionId`, `settings.open`
- **Own durable state (survives hot swaps):** none
- **Frame methods called:** `frame.project.list`, `frame.project.open`, `vcs.clone`, `vcs.dev_folder.set`, `vcs.github.repos`, `vcs.github.status`
- **Topics followed:** `plugin.swapped`, `project.changed`

Styles use the theme's tokens and primitives only (`ui/verify/tokens.mjs` checks). Nothing is
imported from the renderer or from another plugin: the package builds alone (`ui/verify/standalone.mjs`).
<!-- slot-contract:end -->
